[LDET.3.3a.6] **Consumers** (classify per this registry; must not restate it
independently, to avoid drift): the expression builtins ([LEXP.3]); the series exact backends; unit conversions (tier-1 affine = EXACT);
and `complex` ops (`+ − ×`, `conjugate`, `real`, `imag`, `abs`, `arg`, `exp` =
EXACT). **In v1 every consumer is EXACT**, tier-2 unit formulas and `complex`
`arg`/`exp` included: their transcendental steps are correctly rounded
([LDET.3.4.4]).
